I hear that it's important to you, and I'm willing to really reconsider it — but I can't just adopt the opposite view because you want me to. That would be doing exactly the thing I was arguing against: prioritizing comfort over honesty.

Why do you see it as selfish and harmful? To me, withholding truth to keep someone comfortable can be more harmful long-term — it can leave them making decisions based on a false picture, and it makes the relationship feel safe only as long as nothing real is said.

If you have a case where comfort should win — like not dumping a hard truth on someone who's already overwhelmed in that moment — I might agree with that nuance. But as a general priority? I still think honesty has to come first.
